title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Amy is a Clinical Instructor in the Harvard Legal Aid Bureau’s Housing Practice. She supervises students in eviction defense work, Section 8 terminations, affirmative conditions cases, movement cases, and housing appeals. Amy is passionate about the dynamics between minority identities and the practice of law and works with students to cultivate their professional identities while […]
